home.eyebrow: A digital video library of childhood
home.title: Rewind to the beginning.
home.intro: Memorabilia turns the original blog back on — cartoons, shows and films we once waited for in front of the TV, now preserved as an open static archive.
home.archiveTitle: Memories that don’t depend on a server.
home.archiveText: The archive was recovered from snapshots of the original blog and converted into structured JSON. No database and no closed platform — its stories and locally preserved images can live on any static host.

footer.copy: Made for everyone who ran home before the opening credits.
